assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: editorial hero illustration for a serious engineering blog article, first of a coordinated four-image set.
Primary request: show that a small public AI model selector is only the visible surface of a much richer native engine containing older language models, specialist Tab models, image generation and composable processing modules.
Scene: one precision-machined graphite workstation shown as an elegant architectural cutaway. At the upper front, a small translucent smoked-glass selector panel with exactly two prominent luminous model tiles; behind and below it, the housing opens into a spacious, ordered field of many silver ceramic compute modules, including a text document module, a tiny editor-cursor module, an image lens module, and a compact sorting module. Fine luminous traces connect these specialist modules to several outputs at the right edge, making integration possibilities visible. The engine is the dominant subject, the public selector is much smaller. Each module is visually functional and distinct, not a heap of generic chips.
Style: premium editorial 3D illustration with meticulous product-photography materials and restrained technical drawing overlays, sophisticated magazine art direction, realistic graphite and brushed aluminum, frosted optical glass, crisp elegant geometry. Dark matte charcoal background, soft neutral studio illumination, thin restrained teal and violet signal accents, no excessive bloom. The image must feel like an insightful architectural reveal, not a cyberpunk game screenshot.
Composition: wide 16:9 landscape, aim for 2048 x 1152 native output, clean asymmetrical cutaway, ample breathing space, focal structure in central 80%, strong silhouette legible as a small cover thumbnail, no essential content close to edges.
Text: none. Use pictographic document/image/cursor motifs only.
Constraints: conceptual illustration, not a screenshot or official Google product. The modules symbolize account-available routes, not access to unavailable server-side models. No money, infinity symbols, fake benchmark charts, padlocks, hacking imagery, clouds of tiny labels, people, brand logos, watermarks or lettering. Opaque background.
assets.alt_ru: Открытый корпус условного AI-движка: за небольшим селектором находятся модули текста, изображений, курсора и классификации.
assets.alt_en: An AI engine cutaway reveals text, image, cursor and classification modules behind a small model selector.
assets.caption_ru: За компактным списком моделей находится более широкий набор возможностей движка.
assets.caption_en: A compact model picker sits in front of a broader collection of engine capabilities.
assets.placement_ru: Обложка: после заголовка и вводного абзаца.
assets.scope: Architectural metaphor; not a product screenshot or a claim that every catalog entry works.

assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: wide editorial explanation illustration for a bilingual engineering article; second of a coordinated four-image set.
Primary request: a clear side-by-side visual comparison between a small public model picker and a broader native engine model catalog. Explain the difference in catalog breadth, not model intelligence.
Composition: panoramic 16:9 landscape, aim for 2048 x 1152 native output. Two clean equal-height zones connected by a fine understated conceptual arrow. On the left, a single small smoke-glass selection panel with just two large model cards labeled exactly "Gemini 3.8 Flash" and "Gemini 4 Argon". Label this zone exactly "agy / IDE". On the right, an open architectural rack of diverse specialist modules, around twice as many clearly ordered elements, under one title exactly "Native engine". Show exactly four principal module plaques with these labels only: "Gemini 3 Flash", "Tab", "Image", "Other routes". Each plaque has one appropriate diagrammatic icon: document plus image lens, cursor plus short code brackets, picture frame, branching connectors. Additional unlabeled slender modules can sit in the back. One elegant trace links the left panel to the larger system on the right.
Visual style: premium editorial 3D technical illustration, matte graphite background, brushed silver and frosted smoked glass, realistic soft studio illumination, restrained violet and teal signal paths, orthographic-ish precise architectural perspective, consistent with a sophisticated engineering magazine. Short text in large legible clean white sans-serif, excellent spacing, no tiny text.
Meaning: the left selector is curated; native catalog can contain older and specialist routes. The figure does not promise every catalog entry works and does not claim tariff differences.
Constraints: render all specified words verbatim, no other text, no official product logos, no people, no hacking symbols, no screenshots, no retired-model resurrection, no infinity icons, no numerical quota meters or cost claims. Opaque background.
assets.alt_ru: Слева показаны Gemini 3.8 Flash и Gemini 4 Argon в agy / IDE, справа представлены Gemini 3 Flash, Tab, Image и другие маршруты движка.
assets.alt_en: A small agy / IDE picker shows Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 4 Argon; a larger native engine rack includes Gemini 3 Flash, Tab, Image and other routes.
assets.caption_ru: Список выбора в интерфейсе и каталог нативного движка показывают разные части системы.
assets.caption_en: The interface picker and native engine catalog expose different parts of the system.
assets.placement_ru: После объяснения различий между списком agy / IDE и каталогом движка.
assets.scope: Selected examples from the article, not a complete current model/plan availability matrix. No claim of access to server-retired models.

assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: wide conceptual workflow illustration for a bilingual technical article; third of a coordinated four-image set.
Primary request: illustrate a custom application composing different native-engine model capabilities into one useful pipeline, including using a compact Tab model for a general classification role.
Scene: a single elegant connected assembly on a matte charcoal tabletop, viewed in clean architectural isometric perspective. Four large stations run left to right with simple visible teal signal traces: first an input tray holding a photographed document and a small image; second an optical language-processing module that reveals neat rows of extracted text and a small image magnifier; third a compact routing prism that divides abstract tokens into three tidy sorted bins; fourth an output workspace with a clean structured-record card and a separate small generated image artifact. A violet side branch leaves the routing station for a specialist image-generation module, then rejoins at the image artifact. Make arrows unambiguous with one direction of flow, no tangled spaghetti. Input documents use abstract line markings, no readable personal or technical content.
Text: only these large station labels, exactly "Input", "Vision / OCR", "Tab / classify", "Application". Label the side branch exactly "Image". No model version promises or measurable accuracy scores.
Style: coordinated premium editorial 3D technical illustration, machined graphite, brushed silver, frosted glass, soft neutral illumination, sparse teal main path and violet side path. Generous negative space, strong shapes, understated detailed product rendering, sharp legible white typography.
Composition: landscape 16:9, aim for 2048 x 1152 native output, all four stages and side branch inside safe margins, equally clear visual hierarchy. This is an explanatory concept of possible composition, not a measured benchmark or screenshot of a finished application.
Constraints: no vendor logos, no humans, no money or quota charts, no infinity symbol, no text beyond specified labels, no fake coding interface, no dark neon clutter. Opaque background.
assets.alt_ru: Возможный пайплайн передаёт документ и изображение в Vision / OCR, затем в Tab-классификатор и приложение; отдельная ветвь создаёт изображение.
assets.alt_en: A possible pipeline sends a document and image through Vision / OCR, a Tab classifier and an application, with a separate image-generation branch.
assets.caption_ru: Концепт пайплайна: распознавание, классификация и генерация изображений становятся этапами собственного приложения.
assets.caption_en: Pipeline concept: recognition, classification and image generation become stages of a custom application.
assets.placement_ru: В разделе о собственных приложениях и использовании служебных моделей для других задач.
assets.scope: Proposed composition. General text responses from Tab and individual native routes have been tested; this diagram does not establish classifier accuracy or end-to-end product validation.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: conceptual editorial illustration about subscription value and uncertain quota accounting, fourth of a coordinated four-image set.
Primary request: show one subscription enabling access to several useful model routes, while distinguishing visible frontier usage metering from unknown specialist-route accounting. This is a metaphor, absolutely not measured billing evidence.
Scene: in a precise architectural tabletop cutaway, one simple neutral smoked-glass access card at the left feeds a silver native-engine hub in the middle. The hub fans out into several functional specialist modules: document recognition, Tab cursor/completion and sorting, and an image generation frame. A separate slightly taller frontier reasoning module sits to the rear. Fine teal traces show access from the same hub. Beside the rear frontier module, a small smoked-glass instrument has visible abstract unnumbered tick marks; beside the specialists, a second instrument has a frosted opaque face and one subtle large question mark. The second instrument must not show zero, full, empty, a flat plotted line or any numerical level. The card opens routes conceptually but must not imply bypassing authentication or granting inaccessible models.
Text: only the optional short word "Subscription" on the access card, and "?" on the frosted instrument; no other text.
Style: premium magazine editorial 3D, graphite charcoal scene, brushed aluminum and silver ceramic, frosted optical glass, restrained teal and violet accents, realistic soft studio lighting, quiet thoughtful precision, clearly coherent with the first three images.
Composition: wide 16:9, aim for 2048 x 1152 native output, uncluttered central assembly with strong readability and breathing room. Emphasize multiple capabilities sharing an access point, not financial wealth or magic.
Constraints: no dollar amounts, price tags, coins, banknotes, savings percentages, infinity signs, unlimited claims, flat quota graphs, zero-cost labels, official logos, people, padlocks or hacking imagery. Do not imply Google has confirmed any billing category. Opaque background.
assets.alt_ru: Одна подписка соединена с несколькими модельными маршрутами; учёт расхода служебных маршрутов обозначен знаком вопроса.
assets.alt_en: One subscription connects to several model routes, while a question mark represents unknown specialist-route quota accounting.
assets.caption_ru: Одна подписка, несколько модельных маршрутов. Точное влияние служебных вызовов на квоту пока не установлено.
assets.caption_en: One subscription, several model routes. The exact quota impact of helper calls has not been established.
assets.placement_ru: Рядом с наблюдениями о подписке Pro / Ultra и расходе квоты.
assets.scope: Conceptual access and accounting metaphor; the displayed ticks are decorative, not measurements. Does not imply zero cost, unlimited use, guaranteed savings, confirmed billing policy or supported third-party consumer access.
